name: Mathematics, Ph.D.
department: College of Science — Department of Mathematics

deadline.value: 2027/2028 September Entry Second Round online application deadline is January 28, 2027 at 4:00 PM GMT+8 (Round 2 opens December 1, 2026; Round 1 closed November 19, 2026).
deadline.quote: 2027 September Entry Dates & Deadlines | 1st Round (2026-2027) | 2nd Round (2026-2027) | Online application deadline | November 19 | January 28

also.quote: Doctoral Degree | 2027/2028 First Semester Second Round

gre_subject.value: Neither NTU's 2027/2028 Admission Guidelines nor this department's OIA application requirements page states a GRE Subject Test requirement.

supervisor.value: This department's 2027/2028 OIA application requirements page does not state a pre-application supervisor contact requirement.

funding.value: International PhD applicants may apply concurrently for NTU International Graduate Student Scholarships (via checkbox in the online application, no extra documents required), college/department fellowships (such as EECS Global Elite Cultivation Fellowship at NT$20,000/month up to 4 years, College of Medicine International Student Scholarship, or Academia Sinica TIGP Scholarship), and Taiwan MOE/MOFA Scholarships.
funding.quote: VII. Scholarships | NTU provides a variety of scholarships for international degree students. Applicants will be asked whether to apply for NTU scholarships during the online degree application. No extra documents are needed.

also.quote: NTU has many scholarships available for overseas students that can be applied for along with submitting your application. The government of Taiwan, other organizations, and your respective colleges also provide scholarships for international students.

entry_route.value: NTU's 2027/2028 Admission Guidelines require a Master's degree (or MOE-recognized equivalent educational level) to apply for PhD programs (direct-entry doctoral admission for graduating undergraduates is restricted to the Graduate School of Advanced Technology).
entry_route.quote: Applicants with a high school diploma are eligible to apply for undergraduate programs, a Bachelor’s degree for Master’s programs, and a Master’s degree for PhD programs.

notes: English-taught PhD program in the Department of Mathematics covering pure mathematics (algebra, analysis, geometry), applied and computational mathematics, and statistical sciences (NTU's Institute of Statistics and Data Science and Master Program in Statistics are Master's-only).
